MyFantasyLeague member fixtures (Lane 67): documented shapes and guesses, not recorded exchanges.

No member session for the founder's test league was on hand, so none of these
files is a capture. Each is marked DOCUMENTED (the shape MyFantasyLeague's
public API documentation gives, https://api.myfantasyleague.com/2026/api_info:
"Authentication", "Import requests", the login and myleagues entries),
TRIMMED (cut from a recorded public answer in api/internal/leaguesync/replay/mfl)
or GUESSED (our own words or shape, standing in until the proof move captures
the real answer; a test that passes on a GUESSED file proves nothing about
MyFantasyLeague).

  login-ok.xml             DOCUMENTED  the login answer, <status> carrying MFL_USER_ID
  login-refused.xml        GUESSED     the login refusal's words ("Invalid Password"); any <error> counts as refused
  myleagues.json           DOCUMENTED  TYPE=myleagues&FRANCHISE_NAMES=1 for a session, the wwwNN url per league
  league-member.json       TRIMMED     TYPE=league
  rosters-member.json      TRIMMED     TYPE=rosters
  status-member.json       TRIMMED     fflnetdynamic{year}/mfl_status.json, week 7
  live-member.json         TRIMMED     TYPE=liveScoring before the swap, the member's franchise in a matchup
  live-member-after.json   TRIMMED     the same after the swap (assumes no export cache lag after the import)
  live-member-absent.json  GUESSED     a liveScoring that lists the member's franchise nowhere
  live-member-alone.json   GUESSED     a league with no head-to-head games, franchises listed outside any matchup
  import-ok.xml            DOCUMENTED  an import's success, <status>OK</status>
  import-locked.xml        GUESSED     an import refused for a started game ("Lineup is locked: ...")
  import-invalid.xml       TRIMMED     an import refused for its parameters (the export refusal's recorded words)
  pending-trades-member.json  RECORDED ELSEWHERE  TYPE=pendingTrades (Lane 279): the two-row owner-view answer saved
                           from a league clone in bborchardt/fuadmflsite tools/verify/screens/pendingTrades-offer.json,
                           its franchises, player ids and team names set to this league's, plus a third row carrying a
                           draft pick (DP_02_05) beside a player
  pending-trades-one.json  RECORDED ELSEWHERE  the same source's one-row answer (pendingTrades.json), one offer as an
                           object rather than a list, ids set the same way

The proof move (the lane 67 report) captures the login answer and its cookie
expiry, myleagues, liveScoring with the member's team, the import's success,
the read-back right after it, and a lock refusal: replace these files with the
captures (values replaced by types, no session in them), mark each RECORDED
with its date, and keep this list true.
